title: Find the area under a parametric curve using Area = integral of y (dx/dt) dt
content: For a curve given parametrically by x = x(t), y = y(t), the area between the curve, the x-axis, and vertical boundary lines can be found using Area = integral of y*(dx/dt) dt, integrating with respect to the parameter t rather than x. First find dx/dt, multiply by y(t), simplify the resulting expression (often using trig identities such as double-angle formulae), then convert the x-limits into the corresponding t-limits before integrating.
